newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bertelsmann to form venture with Debis.
newsitem.headline: Bertelsmann to form venture with Debis.

text.p: German publishing group Bertelsmann said it planned to announce next Wednesday a 50-50 telecommunications joint venture with Daimler-Benz AG subsidiary Debis.
Bertelsmann spokesman Helmuth Runde said the venture would deal with networks, but declined to give details.
Bertelsmann director Thomas Middelhoff and Debis chief executive Klaus Mangold will give further information at a news conference on Wednesday in Berlin, he said.
